'''Shake Dew from the Branch''' is a [[sword form]]. It is used to deliver six sharp blows that can be divided amongst several opponents. [[Gawyn Trakand]] used this form against [[Marlesh]] and [[Sleete]] during their training.{{ref/book|12|13}}
